title: FTC and Colorado AG sue Greystar over hidden mandatory rental fees
subject: greystar
outlet: Federal Trade Commission / U.S. District Court, D. Colo. (No. 1:25-cv-00165)
summary: The FTC and the State of Colorado sued Greystar Real Estate Partners and five affiliates, alleging that since at least 2019 the company advertised deceptively low base rents while failing to disclose mandatory monthly fees (pest control, valet trash, package, utility-administration and amenity fees), often until after a non-refundable application fee was paid. Claims were brought under the FTC Act, the Gramm-Leach-Bliley Act and the Colorado Consumer Protection Act.
status: resolved by stipulated order Dec 2025 (see $24M settlement)

title: Greystar agrees to pay $24 million to settle FTC and Colorado hidden-fee case
subject: greystar
outlet: Federal Trade Commission
summary: Greystar agreed to pay $23 million to the FTC (for consumer refunds) and $1 million to Colorado, and to clearly and conspicuously display total monthly leasing prices including mandatory fees. The Colorado AG's companion release is at coag.gov/press-releases/weiser-ftc-announce-24m-settlement-with-greystar/.

title: Arizona AG announces three settlements with Greystar over hidden rental charges and junk fees
subject: greystar
outlet: Arizona Attorney General
summary: Arizona AG Kris Mayes announced three Assurances of Discontinuance entered in Maricopa County Superior Court: one adopting the injunctive terms of the FTC/Colorado settlement (with about $1.5M in anticipated restitution to Arizona consumers from the FTC fund), and two resolving alleged Arizona Consumer Fraud Act junk-fee violations at The Julia and Avana Gilbert with a combined $100,000 in restitution.

title: Justice Department adds Greystar and five other landlords to RealPage antitrust suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Justice, Antitrust Division / U.S. District Court, M.D.N.C. (No. 1:24-cv-00710)
summary: DOJ and state co-plaintiffs (including North Carolina) filed an amended complaint naming Greystar, LivCor, Camden, Cushman & Wakefield/Pinnacle, Willow Bridge and Cortland, alleging they shared competitively sensitive data through RealPage's pricing algorithms and communicated directly about rents and occupancy. The complaint alleged, as one example, that Greystar supplied Camden with recent renewal rates and pricing approach information.
status: Greystar resolved via consent decree (see DOJ settlement)

title: DOJ reaches proposed settlement with Greystar to end its participation in algorithmic pricing
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Justice, Office of Public Affairs
summary: DOJ filed a proposed final judgment barring Greystar from using rent-pricing software trained on or using other owners' nonpublic data, from sharing competitively sensitive data with rivals, and from attending RealPage-hosted meetings, and requiring cooperation in the ongoing case. Greystar said the settlement contained no admission of wrongdoing.

title: Nine state attorneys general reach $7 million settlement with Greystar over algorithmic rent pricing
subject: greystar
outlet: California Attorney General (multistate coalition)
summary: The attorneys general of California, Colorado, Connecticut, Illinois, Massachusetts, Minnesota, North Carolina, Oregon and Tennessee filed a proposed $7 million settlement resolving their claims against Greystar Management Services in the January 2025 RealPage litigation. Greystar agreed to stop using pricing algorithms that rely on competitors' confidential data, accept a court-appointed monitor if using third-party pricing software, and cooperate against remaining defendants.

title: Greystar agrees to $50 million settlement in renters' RealPage price-fixing class action
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, M.D. Tenn. (In re RealPage, Inc., Rental Software Antitrust Litigation (No. II), 3:23-md-03071)
summary: In the consolidated private antitrust MDL alleging landlords used RealPage software to align rents, Greystar agreed to pay $50 million as part of more than $141 million in proposed settlements filed with 25+ landlords, and to stop sharing nonpublic data with RealPage. Greystar announced an agreement in principle on Aug. 8, 2025, stating it admitted no wrongdoing.

title: D.C. Attorney General sues RealPage and 14 landlords, including Greystar, for rental price-fixing
subject: greystar
outlet: Office of the Attorney General for the District of Columbia
summary: The D.C. OAG complaint names Greystar Management Services, L.P. among 14 landlords alleged to have collectively delegated rent-setting to RealPage's revenue-management software in violation of the District's Antitrust Act. It alleges Greystar operates about 7,730 D.C. units and used RealPage software at buildings including The Gantry and Illume.
status: pending as to Greystar (no Greystar settlement found)

title: Arizona AG sues RealPage and nine landlords, including Greystar, over alleged rent price-fixing
subject: greystar
outlet: Arizona Attorney General
summary: Arizona alleged RealPage and nine landlords, including Greystar Management Services, L.P., conspired to raise rents in the Phoenix and Tucson metro areas by pooling competitively sensitive pricing and occupancy data in RealPage's software.

title: Washington AG sues RealPage and landlords including Greystar over alleged rent price-fixing
subject: greystar
outlet: Washington State Attorney General
summary: Filed in King County Superior Court, the suit names Greystar Management Services, LLC and GREP Washington, LLC among landlords alleged to have conspired with RealPage to raise and stabilize rents and exchange nonpublic competitive information in Washington.

title: New Jersey AG sues RealPage and 10 landlords including Greystar for alleged rent collusion
subject: greystar
outlet: New Jersey Office of Attorney General / U.S. District Court, D.N.J.
summary: New Jersey alleged RealPage and 10 large landlords, including Greystar Management Services LLC, violated the Sherman Act, the New Jersey Antitrust Act and the Consumer Fraud Act by using RealPage's algorithmic pricing and exchanging nonpublic data to inflate rents.

title: Kentucky AG sues RealPage and landlords including Greystar; Greystar later settles
subject: greystar
outlet: Kentucky Attorney General / U.S. District Court, E.D. Ky.
summary: Kentucky AG Russell Coleman sued RealPage and several landlords, including Greystar Real Estate Partners, alleging algorithmic price-fixing in violation of federal antitrust law and the Kentucky Consumer Protection Act. According to PYMNTS (July 21, 2026), Kentucky reached a settlement with Greystar Management Services; terms were not disclosed in public filings.

title: Greystar to pay over $1.4M for early-termination charges on military servicemembers
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Justice, Civil Rights Division / U.S. Attorney, D.S.C.
summary: DOJ alleged Greystar Management Services violated the Servicemembers Civil Relief Act by imposing early-termination charges on servicemembers who ended leases after receiving relocation orders, relying on software it knew would impose the charges automatically. Greystar agreed to set aside $1.35M for affected servicemembers and co-tenants (treble damages for those who paid), pay a $77,370 civil penalty, and adopt SCRA-compliant software and forms.

title: Greystar Management Services pays $25,000 to settle EEOC pregnancy discrimination suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. EEOC / U.S. District Court, D. Md. (No. 11-cv-02789)
summary: The EEOC sued in October 2011 alleging Greystar fired a housekeeper at a Rockville, Md., apartment complex after she disclosed her pregnancy and demanded medical documentation clearing her to work with cleaning chemicals. A 30-month consent decree required $25,000 in relief, an anti-discrimination policy, manager training and a posted notice.

title: EEOC sues Greystar Holdings for retaliating against employee over harassment complaint
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. EEOC / U.S. District Court, D. Ariz. (CV-09-2003-PHX-FJM)
summary: The EEOC alleged Greystar Holdings, Inc. (d/b/a Greystar Real Estate Partners) gave a former employee a negative reference and recommended against hiring her because she had filed a sexual harassment complaint, in violation of Title VII.

title: HUD conciliation agreement with Greystar over alleged harassment of Hispanic tenants in Nashville
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development (FHEO Case No. 04-12-0360-8)
summary: A HUD Secretary-initiated Fair Housing Act complaint filed Feb. 10, 2012 alleged TriTex Real Estate Advisors and Greystar Management Services subjected Hispanic residents of the 233-unit Clairmont Apartments to different terms, intimidation and harassment based on national origin. Respondents denied discrimination and entered a conciliation agreement without any finding of liability.

title: Greystar California agrees to revise tenant screening statewide after fair housing complaint
subject: greystar
outlet: California Civil Rights Department
summary: CRD announced a settlement with Greystar California, Inc. after a complaint alleging an applicant at a Hollywood apartment complex was denied based on criminal history without an opportunity to explain. Greystar agreed to review and revise screening policies statewide, notify staff of California's criminal-history protections, train specified Southern California staff, and pay the complainant $10,000.

title: Housing watchdog files 114 voucher-discrimination complaints against Greystar with seven state and D.C. agencies
subject: greystar
location: CA, HI, MD, MI, NJ, VA, DC
outlet: Cohen Milstein (counsel) / Housing Rights Initiative
summary: Housing Rights Initiative filed complaints with the Virginia OAG, California CRD, Maryland Commission on Civil Rights, Hawai'i Civil Rights Commission, Michigan DCR, New Jersey DCR and D.C. Office of Human Rights alleging 114 violations of source-of-income laws. The complaints allege, based on undercover testing, that Greystar properties rejected Housing Choice Voucher holders, imposed unlawful conditions, and refused to count voucher assistance toward income requirements.

title: Greystar enters fair housing agreement with Equal Rights Center after Virginia voucher testing
subject: greystar
outlet: Equal Rights Center
summary: Following a civil rights testing investigation by the Equal Rights Center (a fair housing nonprofit, not a government agency), GREP Atlantic, LLC agreed to a five-year agreement covering all Greystar-managed Virginia properties: income requirements based only on the tenant's rent share for voucher holders, no credit-score screening where a voucher covers full rent, signage and training, and 20 compliance tests.

title: Class action accuses Greystar and nine other managers of hiding Facebook housing ads from older renters
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, D. Md. (Opiotennione v. Bozzuto Management Co., 8:20-cv-01956)
summary: Housing Rights Initiative and an older D.C. resident sued 10 property managers, including Greystar, alleging they targeted Facebook apartment ads to exclude users over 50; they had earlier filed age-bias charges with D.C. and Montgomery County human rights offices (Sept. 2019). The district case closed in July 2021 and the Fourth Circuit affirmed dismissal on standing grounds in March 2025.

title: Hall v. Greystar Management Services: Fair Housing Act retaliation and eviction-property suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, D. Md. (No. 1:13-cv-03615), 179 F. Supp. 3d 534
summary: A former tenant sued Greystar Management Services, a landscaping contractor and a sheriff's lieutenant, alleging Fair Housing Act retaliation, conversion and constitutional claims arising from the alleged deprivation of her personal property during a December 2011 eviction. The case went to the Fourth Circuit (No. 14-2145) and back; the district court issued further rulings in 2016 and the docket closed in February 2017 without a judgment for the plaintiff.

title: Grant v. Greystar: Kapilina Beach Homes tenant files federal RICO/fraud suit
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, D. Haw. (No. 1:25-cv-00300)
summary: A self-represented tenant sued Greystar Real Estate Partners, Kapilina Beach Homes and utility-billing firm Conservice, pleading civil RICO and fraud claims (docket nature of suit: 'Other Fraud'); prior research notes the complaint also invokes Hawaii's anti-retaliation statute in connection with a utility-billing dispute.

title: Gamez v. Greystar: pro se civil rights suit naming Greystar and CEO Bob Faith
subject: greystar
bob-faith
outlet: U.S. District Court, E.D. Wash. (No. 2:23-cv-00015); 9th Cir. No. 23-35403
summary: A self-represented tenant filed a civil rights suit against Greystar Real Estate Partners, Bob Faith (individually and in his official capacity), a property-owning LLC, Spokane County, a law firm and others. The district case closed in May 2023; the Ninth Circuit appeal, which the clerk flagged as possibly frivolous, closed in September 2023.

title: Littleton tenant sues Greystar alleging eviction in retaliation for silica dust complaints
subject: greystar
outlet: Denver7 (KMGH)
summary: A former tenant sued Greystar Management Services and a concrete contractor, alleging he was exposed to silica dust from concrete work, reported it to Greystar and OSHA (which fined the contractor more than $58,000), and was then evicted for allegedly 'photographing the vendors without consent.' Greystar denies most allegations and says it had no control over the contractor's work.

title: Class action alleges Greystar charged California tenants undisclosed junk fees
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, S.D. Cal. (Wu et al. v. Greystar Real Estate Partners, LLC, 3:25-cv-01090)
summary: The proposed class action alleges Greystar 'drip priced' California rentals by charging mandatory fees for pest control, trash and utility administration not included in advertised rent, in violation of the UCL, False Advertising Law, CLRA and California's Honest Pricing Law.

title: Class action challenges Greystar late-fee and penalty practices in California
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, N.D. Cal. (Zeff v. Greystar Real Estate Partners, LLC, 3:20-cv-07122)
summary: The complaint alleges Greystar charged $100 late fees untethered to actual damages, applied rent payments to prior penalties first so late fees 'stacked' month to month, charged unauthorized $3.95 utility-administration fees, and mishandled security-deposit deductions and return timelines under California law.

title: Colorado tenant class action accuses Greystar of charging inflated junk fees
subject: greystar
outlet: District Court, Denver County, Colorado (Collins v. GREP Southwest, LLC d/b/a Greystar)
summary: The class complaint alleges Greystar forced thousands of Colorado tenants to pay inflated, late-disclosed 'junk fees' on top of advertised rent that provided no benefit beyond ordinary landlord costs, and seeks to stop the practice and recover damages.

title: Greystar pays $4.665 million to settle North Carolina eviction-fee class action
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, M.D.N.C. (Wallace v. Greystar Real Estate Partners, LLC, 1:18-cv-00501)
summary: Tenants alleged Greystar unlawfully charged North Carolina residents filing fees, sheriff service fees and attorneys' fees in eviction actions and threatened such fees in collection letters (2014-2018), in violation of state rental and debt-collection law. Greystar agreed to a $4,665,000 class settlement without admitting wrongdoing (final approval hearing July 22, 2022).

title: Greystar pays $2.5 million to settle Washington tenant screening-fee class action
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, E.D. Wash. (Daley v. Greystar, 2:18-cv-00381)
summary: The class alleged Greystar charged rental applicants in Washington tenant-screening fees without the advance disclosures state law requires (applications June 2016 - August 2020). Greystar denied wrongdoing and agreed to a $2.5 million settlement, which received final approval Feb. 1, 2022.

title: Employee lawsuit alleges Greystar miscalculated overtime by excluding bonuses
subject: greystar
outlet: U.S. District Court, N.D. Tex. (Norris v. Greystar Management Services LP, 3:17-cv-01956)
summary: A proposed collective action under the Fair Labor Standards Act alleges Greystar Management Services failed to include non-discretionary bonuses in the regular rate used to compute overtime pay.

title: Dallas jury returns $860 million verdict against Greystar over fatal 2019 crane collapse
subject: greystar
outlet: The Real Deal (Dallas County district court verdict)
summary: A Dallas County jury awarded about $860 million to the parents of a resident killed when a tower crane at a Greystar development collapsed onto the neighboring Elan City Lights apartments during a June 2019 storm. Plaintiffs argued Greystar let the crane's inspection lapse and was responsible for the crane not being left in weathervane mode; the jury found crane owner Bigge not liable.

title: More than 50 displaced residents sue Greystar over 2020 Avana on Main apartment fire
subject: greystar
outlet: State Court of Fulton County, Georgia (No. 21EV004936)
summary: Residents displaced by the Aug. 19, 2020 fire at Avana on Main sued GS Main Street, LLC, Greystar Management Services, L.P. and a service technician, seeking damages arising from the fire.

title: Boston tenants' class action alleges Greystar entity charged unlawful eviction legal fees
subject: greystar
outlet: Boston Globe (U.S. District Court, D. Mass.)
summary: Tenants of The Eddy in East Boston sued Greystar affiliate GREP Atlantic and the building owner, alleging 'eviction/legal recovery' fees were charged without a court judgment, in violation of the Massachusetts Consumer Protection Act. The court dismissed one claim but allowed two to proceed, and allowed some Greystar counterclaims.

title: Washington class action challenges Greystar lease buy-out and reletting charges
subject: greystar
outlet: King County Superior Court (per plaintiffs' counsel Schroeter Goldmark & Bender)
summary: Filed on behalf of tenants who moved out early and were charged, or had deposits applied to, buy-out fees, reletting charges and/or future rent. Greystar removed the case to federal court, which remanded it to King County Superior Court.

title: NLRB issues complaint against Greystar Management Services over coercive work rules
subject: greystar
outlet: National Labor Relations Board (Case 09-CA-190927)
summary: After an unfair labor practice charge filed in January 2017, the NLRB regional office issued a complaint and notice of hearing alleging violations of Section 8(a)(1), including coercive rules and retaliation for concerted activity. A Regional Director order was issued in June 2018 and the case is closed.

title: Greystar notifies Washington AG of data breach involving employee email account
subject: greystar
outlet: Washington State Attorney General (data breach notification filing)
summary: Greystar Real Estate Partners filed a breach notice stating an unauthorized party accessed an employee email account between May 1 and May 18, 2026 and acquired files containing personal information; affected people were offered 24 months of credit monitoring. This is a mandatory disclosure, not an enforcement action; no lawsuit over this breach was found.

title: Prop 65 notice alleges formaldehyde exposure at Greystar-managed Forty55 Lofts
subject: greystar
outlet: California Attorney General, Proposition 65 60-Day Notice (AG No. 2021-02813)
summary: A private noticing party filed a Proposition 65 60-day notice alleging exposure to formaldehyde gas from laminate flooring, cabinetry and/or other building materials, naming GS Redwood Property LLC, GS Redwood REIT LLC, Greystar Real Estate Partners LLC, Greystar California Inc. and Greystar Worldwide LLLC.
